tables.name: files_events
tables.retention: 365 days (append-only audit; actor ID only, no personal paths)

tables.name: files_favorites
tables.retention: Until the user removes the favorite (at most 500 per user)

tables.name: files_jobs
tables.retention: Legacy and empty: files SQL 006 moved its rows to platform_jobs (ADR 0010; Files jobs there are removed 7 days after they end and at once when the account is deleted, see RemoveDeletedUsers); dropped in a later contract step

tables.name: files_removals
tables.retention: Permanent (one row per deleted account: when it was seen and emptied)
